name: phone-mockup
title: Phone Mockup
description: An original mobile device frame with a replaceable screen area, subtle hardware depth, and an ambient presentation stage.
useWhen: You need a polished, self-contained frame for a mobile product screen or prototype.
avoidWhen: The mobile content needs to be interacted with directly in a dense application layout.
responsiveBehavior: The phone stays centered with generous surrounding space and scales down on compact viewports.
accessibility: Uses a descriptive label for the device preview.
Keeps decorative wallpaper and hardware elements hidden from assistive technology.

variants.title: Studio phone
variants.description: A glossy, original device shell with an abstract wallpaper and an adaptable in-screen content card.
accessibility: Treat the device shell as decorative context.
Provide meaningful text alternatives for any inserted screenshots.
